object.description:
The Object is used by an audit event policy subcategories test to define those objects to evaluate based on a specified state.

Therefore, there are no child entities defined.

item.description:
These settings are used to specify which system and network events are monitored.

It is important to note that these audit event policy settings are specific to certain versions of Windows.

description: The `windows.auditeventpolicysubcategories` is used to check the audit event policy settings on a Windows system.
